campaign.concurrency_notes: Four pinned Linux lanes shared a four-vCPU development VM with warm host caches. Each measured process tree had one vCPU. macOS measurements and geometry verification ran on the same host.

method.storage: fresh Docker-managed native Linux volumes, no network/swap, 512 MiB and 1 vCPU
method.common_deliverables: Persist and reopen the editable recipe, source STEP, exact assembly STEP, mesh preview, indexed version and receipt; rebuild 256 distinct parameter sets. Each output checked in separate OCCT.
method.scope: One separate image-startup session per backend is recorded under initial_sessions. The scored runs use three fresh sessions per backend, warmed runtime files and rotated backend order. Charts use checkpoint medians across scored sessions. Late growth is the median paired difference. Current is sampled after a commit at 0, 1 and every fourth edit. Peak is the kernel high-water mark.
method.flexibility: Two deterministic engineering workflows; three backends each accepted seven deliveries and rejected three incompatible replacements.
